Class Intersectable.Intersection

java.lang.Object
geometries.api.Intersectable.Intersection
Enclosing class:
Intersectable
public static final class Intersectable.Intersection extends Object
Represents a single intersection between a ray and a geometry.

Acts as a cache for all per-intersection and per-light-source values computed by the ray tracer, so that each value is computed once and reused throughout the Phong shading calculation.
